fields.v: Criteria stated by the authors: weighted decision compliance (regex + human check) and merge-readiness (binary human judgement: would merge as-is vs requires rework); no cost criterion stated. Averages over 3 runs. -- Claude Code baseline (claude -p, 5-min timeout) + Claude Sonnet 4.6 coding (Opus 4.6 planning per p. 4/12, see Notes): compliance 19/41 (46%); 2/8 tasks at 100%, 2/8 at 0%; 5 blocking violations; merge-ready 2/8; tests written 0; build pass lint/typecheck 100%, tests 0%; total cost $4.13, 3,902K tokens, 165 turns, ~5.1 min/task; per-task cost $0.13-0.67 where reported; cost per merge-ready task $2.07; cost per correct decision $0.22. Quality: no configuration-level criterion stated by the authors (their merge-readiness criterion is per task: met on 2/8 tasks; authors: its runs 'predominantly produce output that requires human rework'); cost: no criterion stated by the authors. Baseline. -- Claude Code + Brief (brief build --confirm, 30-min timeout) + Opus 4.6 planning / Sonnet 4.6 coding: compliance 39/41 (95%); 6/8 tasks at 100%, 0 at 0%; 0 blocking violations; merge-ready 8/8; 838 tests; build pass 100% all; total cost $5.28, 3,867K tokens, 187 turns, ~15 min/task; per-task cost $0.55-0.82 where reported; cost per merge-ready task $0.66; cost per correct decision $0.14. Quality: works (merge-ready on 8/8 tasks); cost: no criterion stated by the authors. Config C (external orchestrator) not reported
fields.quote: then assessed merge-readiness on a binary scale (would merge as-is vs. requires rework).
fields.why: Merge-readiness is a per-task criterion; the authors set no share of merge-ready tasks for a configuration to work, so 'partly' for 2/8 rests on a threshold chosen by the extractor (8/8 for Brief meets the criterion on every task).
fields.doubt: O critério dos autores (pronto a fazer merge) é por tarefa; não dizem quantas tarefas em 8 bastam para a configuração funcionar. 'Parcialmente' para 2/8 é um limiar teu. Vê a pág. 5 e decide se mantens ou passas a 'sem critério dos autores' (como noutros estudos com critério só por tarefa).

fields.v: Partly (0.5): the authors present their own product Brief (context retrieval + spec generation + mid-build consultation) as the approach; requirements partly stated: Claude Code with Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, API cost about $0.55-0.82 and about 15 min per task; Brief licence cost and infrastructure Not stated
fields.quote: Our contribution is demonstrating that LLM agents benefit from the same principle, and that product-context retrieval can automate specification generation.
fields.why: Both authors make Brief and frame context-augmented, spec-generating code generation as their contribution, so the study can be read as proposing (and comparing) an approach, which makes Q13 applicable instead of N/A.
fields.doubt: Os dois autores são da Brief e apresentam o próprio produto e a ideia de gerar specs a partir do contexto como contributo (pág. 3). Se achas que o estudo propõe uma abordagem, a natureza ganha 'Proposes an approach' e Q13 deixa de ser N/A; vê págs. 3-4 e 6-11 e decide.
